 Follow Prince William & Kate Middleton’s Hand-Holding During India Visit Draws Expert Attention
 Sibanee Gogoi Wed, November 18, 2026 at 9:56 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Punit PARANJPE / AFP via Getty Images A tender hand-holding moment between Prince William and Kate Middleton in India has experts talking. The gesture occurred during the royal couple's ongoing three-day Earthshot Prize trip. The Waleses are featuring prominently in the news cycle. This marks their first joint overseas tour since Middleton announced her remission in January 2025
 Body language expert suggests what Kate Middleton and Prince William's hand-holding during their India visit means
 After studying the latest pictures from Kate Middleton and Prince William's second day in India, body language specialist Judi James has shared her observations. The snaps were from the royal couple's appearance at the Children's Earthshot Prize Awards in Mumbai on Tuesday, November 17. Seated in the audience, Princess Catherine gently placed her hand on her husband's arm. Then, with a warm and affectionate smile, she leaned in close to him.
 It was a small gesture, brief, natural, and unforced. But the moment stood out instantly in royal terms. The couple usually keeps public displays of affection to a minimum. In an interview with the Daily Express , body language expert Judi James observed that the display was significant. According to her analysis, Middleton has appeared "more tactile" throughout the India visit. The pair is reportedly "becoming adept at getting their levels of PDA."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement She said, "A sign of William and Kate's new levels of assured confidence as both a high-profile couple and as global ambassadors for the Royal Family comes from their very relaxed and tactile behaviours on this trip. William sits slightly slouched here, clearly enjoying what he is watching and using very natural body language behaviours rather than showing signs of any previous formality and awkwardness or his signature bashfulness."
 According to James, the Princess of Wales is no longer just standing beside William. She is gently guiding the moments, reassuring him with quiet, confident leadership expressed through touch. The behavioral analyst explained that public affection often signals a couple wanting privacy. William and Catherine, however, use it in the opposite way. Their warmth invites others in, and their light humor makes it feel perfectly suited to a world stage.
